# E33 build plan

Status: ready for independent plan review, not implementation greenlight. The design is frozen. Only this directory was edited. `tasks.json` is the exclusive file allocation; each brief includes its own inputs, prerequisites, tests and gates.

## Build order and connections

| Task | Builds | Dependency |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | Pure readiness types, selection, prepare projection and consumer ports | E01 effective contracts, kernel and kernel.testing; P1/P2 decisions before disputed public exports |
| T2 | Structural RTDC parser, verification adapter and CLI | T1; P3/P5 before provider integration |
| T3 | Snapshot query, provider gateways and getReturnReadiness HTTP boundary | T1; P1/P2/P4/P6 before integration |
| T4 | Return, Who decides and No return cards with matched, revocable overlays | E03 generated client/shell and E28 component inputs; P2/P7 |
| T5 | Real HTTP, SQLite, browser, fault and configuration acceptance | T2, T3, T4 and their real hard providers |

Start T1 and T4 independently after their external prerequisites. T2 and T3 run in parallel after T1 freezes its exports. T5 exercises the resulting stack without editing its providers. No second agent rewrites another task's work. Missing dependencies permit protocol tests with SYSTEM 10 kernel fakes, never fake production results or an acceptance pass. E33 is wave 5 and needs real E01, E02, E23 and E28 for acceptance (`docs/SYSTEM.md:2386`). Guidance comes through E28's E27 dependency.

E23 supplies the active environment and current return option under E01's ReadSnapshot. E28 supplies the authorized, bounded return candidates and their plan/ui-copy pins. T1 computes; T3 maps to the generated closed response. T2 verifies saved form structure before content can activate. E28 retains ownership of check 14, content authoring and prepare commands. T4 displays PlanView planning content before any run and applies clinical state only after every identity, pin and grant matches.

Repository inspection found no `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, `contracts/api/`, mission configuration or kernel fakes. Existing `contracts/` and `config/` contain pharmacy artifacts, which remain untouched. `docs/requests/E33.md` is absent. The design's old `research/responder/RS*.txt` inputs are absent too. Available replacements include `docs/product/cliff/forms/ICL48.json` for the RS32 URL, page 5, `ICL36B.json` for RS34 and `ICL7.json` for RS58. The source registry identifies those URLs at `docs/product/NASA-SOURCES.md:107`, `:109` and `:120`; matching still needs E10's pinned import agreement, not a runtime package reader.

All available `docs/build/*/tasks.json` allocations and other designs' section 13 were checked for ownership. None claims E33's readiness package, tests, feature or `eval/scenarios/stay_or_return/`. Test subdirectories in this plan partition the wildcard ownership at `docs/tdd/E33.md:577`; they are new test allocations, not additional product modules. Recheck allocations before dispatch because other planners are active. No task owns configuration, authoring, shared toolchains, shell files or another epic's code.

## End to end proof

T5 calls `create_app(settings)` through HTTP with real middleware, identity, loader, E23 mission, E28 plan services and an on-disk SQLite database in a temporary directory (`docs/SYSTEM.md:119`, `:718`). Browser cases use Playwright against that running hub and the real crew app. Use E21's explicit demo profile and approved E01 clock/fault controls. No hub dependency overrides, repository mocks, direct SQL seeding, intercepted success responses or test-only production branches. Fakes are confined to component tests or documented external optional processes. A missing mandatory provider, source, case or tool fails acceptance; no skip or xfail earns completion.

| Trace and design tests | What the real stack proves |
|---|---|
| R60, UC26, I33-01/02/03/06/07/11/12/13; T33-01/04/05/06/17 | A lunar eye plan shows criteria, four contextual RTDC ranges, trip and Who decides before a run. Starting and preparing changes only recorded state; no decision is computed. Closed/preparing_return and stood_down, unavailable/substituted/absent steps, equal times, environment re-entry and relevant history behind 199 unrelated runs follow selection rules. |
| V94, EI11; T33-01/17 | Switch the same condition to both mars_surface and transit: getReturnReadiness returns 422 with both nullable error fields null; PlanView omits return and the browser displays its configured no_return_text. Mark both cases scenario_V94 and require both T33-01 and T33-17 at collection. |
| H2, I33-05; T33-10/11 | The real proposal and activation paths reject changed values, wrong page, unreadable source and structurally refused tables with exact findings; D8 ETags are enforced and last good remains active. Null RTDC and the unchanged complete example release pass. The independent eye-form golden is page 5, ranges 0..0, 96..100, 0..100, 100..100, checked against ICL48, not derived from the proposed configuration. |
| Charter 6 configuration path; T33-13/14 | Scratch valid releases change labels, trip text without an environment switch, new-run criteria and nullable RTDC without code changes. Selected old runs keep plan/ui-copy pins. Removing applicability and its stage is one atomic release; invalid sole-criterion removal rejects. Concurrent activation cannot produce a mixed snapshot. No safety mapping is edited. |
| Charter 6 durability; T33-19 | Through E28 HTTP actions: crash before/after commit, lost acknowledgment, same-key retry, restart/new-key no-op, late receipt replay, same key on another target, disk full and two-client completion preserve one accepted step and readiness. Audit and durable identity remain E01/E28 mechanisms. |
| Charter 6 privacy; T33-09/12/16 | Owner succeeds; unshared officer, station and other crew learn no clinical state or existence. Explicit complete grants permit only their authorized view; revocation/expiry fences HTTP, events, in-flight responses and memory. Missing field grants deny the closed response. Incapacitated subjects retain fixed help, not a fabricated chart grant. P2 must settle station acceptance before this matrix is final. |
| EI1/EI2, I33-08/09; T33-07/08/15/20 | Same corrected time and inputs yield identical output with model/devices/camera absent and link up, delayed or down. No readiness import or call reads groundlink/model/assistant. Busy storage, stalled calls and missing pins yield typed complete errors, never partial or invented success. |
| H1/H3/H6/H7, V98; T33-16/17 | Browser tests cover all state/pin/run mismatches, all four step states, Not aboard and no eligible officer, late/reordered responses, two clients, SSE loss/reconnect/410, logout and crew switch. Hub loss leaves versioned public planning content with no clinical marks or controls; E28 printed cards are the independent backup. Source and built-client scans find no embedded domain copy. A scratch copy edit changes browser text. |
| Demo exclusion; T33-17 | Render all six existing Mara/plan_icl10 demo acts: no Return or Who decides content and no readiness request. E33 has no D assertion of its own (`docs/tdd/E33.md:20`); this is exclusion evidence, not a new demo feature. |

T33-02/03 remain deterministic component contract comparisons against each example's `value`, using the documented SIM instant, not production seed defaults. Real HTTP tests validate actual generated identifiers and compare clinical fields without forcing example IDs. T33-18 measures the specified p95 below 50 ms on the reference machine with 200 historical runs and records machine/release evidence; it is separate from deterministic unit tests.

Work-package acceptance: E33-01 requires T2's source-checked verifier plus E28's authored/generated eye return stage and T5's T33-11 release-path proof. E33-02 requires T1/T3 and T5's HTTP state, privacy, pin and fallback cases. E33-03 requires T4 and T5's lunar, Mars, transit, V98 and demo-exclusion browser cases, with X3 complete. None is closed by an unavailable-state test alone.

## Requests

Addressed to the coordinator. These are dispatch prerequisites, not accepted decisions. The final instruction permits edits only under docs/build/E33, so the coordinator must create `docs/requests/E33.md` and promote these entries and the design's X1 through X18 there. This plan does not claim a canonical request was filed. Do not reopen settled D5/D6/D7; record their X11/bounds implications as answered.

1. **P1, E01 and coordinator: module row and ownership.** Reconcile SYSTEM 4.2's readiness_run/ReadinessQueries/event row with CONTRACTS 27 computed-on-read. Provide an accepted signature if ReadinessQueries is required. Allocate `hub/src/crew_health/readiness/module.py` and `architecture.toml` for SYSTEM 5.12 registration and the stricter readiness-independence rule, or arrange the permitted owner integration. Reissue the relevant task allocation after approval; no current task edits those files. Acceptance requires convention discovery, route and verifier bindings, mandatory loader inventory and actual import rejection. No state table is proposed by this plan.
2. **P2, E02/E28 and contract coordinator: clinical readiness access.** Apply SYSTEM 8.3 to getReturnReadiness and resolve station's contradictory 200 clause and a request with no selected run. Specify current snapshot-bound owner/object/field authorization, non-enumerating subject lookup through RosterPort, grant scope for candidate selection, and revocation/audience invalidation. Do not return a different unauthorized run, manufacture closed or grant chart access by role. Update effective policy centrally only after acceptance. Settle X9a/X9c (closed preparing_return and environment re-entry) with the revised selection; no lifetime cutoff. Until resolved, the disputed cross-person/station path stays denied and its positive acceptance remains incomplete.
3. **P3, E28/E27/E33 and coordinator: two application seams.** Reconcile E33 4.1 PlanRunQueryPort.return_runs with E28 4.2 PlanRunHistory.return_candidates. Agree the two-candidate, environment-filtered, commit-ordered, snapshot/session-authorized read, return-step and parsed pin DTO mapping; provider code never imports readiness. Resolve the verifier ownership conflict similarly: keep one structural implementation while E28's mandatory 14f and E27's authoring check consume a permitted application protocol bound by composition. Preserve Verified/Mismatch/Refused/SourceUnreadable and exact finding pointers. Confirm internal percent quantities and pin mappings. No dependent adapter is dispatched on a pending signature.
4. **P4, E01: parsed pins and bounded calls.** Supply the shared startup/activation parsed ui-copy binding, including retained pins, and a typed deadline/cancellation mechanism for in-process calls and form reads. Name the validated request/port settings, minima/maxima, error mapping and bound provider reads under one ReadSnapshot. SYSTEM 5.11 supplies storage.busy_timeout_ms but no request deadline. No local cache, guessed key, executor or retry replaces it. Until provided, T3's corresponding integration and T33-20 cannot pass.
5. **P5, E10/E28 and coordinator: provenance and E33-01.** Resolve E10 R-E10-17 FormTextPort export, canonical FormPage type, bounded manifest-pinned RS source mapping and offline import of available saved forms. Verify unchanged example releases against the package plus local source registry. E28 owns the eye-stage proposal at authoring/plans/flows/plan_eye_injury.json, regeneration and its schema-valid checked_by; approve/adopt X18's authoring/plans/rtdc-checks.csv only through E28. Check the actual PDF page independently before publishing numerical content. Additional lunar stages require sourced criteria and independent checks, not inferred flight rules or bulk fetching. CLI entry-point registration X15 belongs to the workspace/CLI owner; python module invocation remains supported.
6. **P6, E01/E20/E21: executable build evidence.** Deliver hub/pyproject.toml, generated guarded contracts, kernel.testing/platform.testing, create_app(settings), real process/SQLite/clock/fault controls, strict marker inventory, Schemathesis, Playwright and the shared client scanner. Register E33 test IDs, V94/V98 clauses, domain/application coverage inventory and compute/rtdc mutation targets in the owners' tooling. validate_hub.py must fail missing inventory, inadequate per-module branch coverage, missing conditions or surviving non-equivalent mutants, rather than report only E01. E21 owns the runner/registry/demo fixture and browser driver, never E33. Confirm stay_or_return ownership under SYSTEM 6.1. No runtime gate was run for a nonexistent member.
7. **P7, E03/E28 and contract coordinator: UI delivery.** X2 requires return/who_decides slots with {planView: PlanView, planRunId: string | null}, exported StepRow and the E03 teardown/stale/client bindings. E28 owns mounting. X3 requires return_words keys rtdc_title, rtdc_note, treated, untreated, best_case, worst_case, range, rtdc_page, rtdc_none, stood_down and open_run, with loader check 13 authorization for {min}/{max}/{page}; E03 owns config/ui-copy.json, coordinator owns schema/effective-contract changes. X12 error-copy gaps retain designed_states.unknown fallback. X10 schema expansion and X13/X14 optional API extensions remain pending: use the current safe projection and no new query/response fields.
8. **Coordinator evidence owners.** Append this planner run and every coder/reviewer run to AI-USE-LOG.md and retain independent plan/build review and CI evidence in their owned paths. Those files are outside this assignment. Maximum build review rounds remain three; local green alone does not greenlight E33.

## Verification

Planning checks passed for JSON shape, unique acyclic dependencies, exact disjoint ownership within frozen section 13, external allocation conflicts, citation targets and prohibited punctuation. The frozen-design command `.venv/bin/python -B scripts/design_lint.py docs/tdd/E33.md --json` exited 1: 12 errors and 14 warnings. Findings include missing required subsections/acceptance matrix, a literal example URL treated as an unknown endpoint, an unrecognized scenario marker, obsolete provider names and unbound enum literals. P6 also asks the coordinator/gate owner to resolve this evidence against the frozen design and plan, with regression evidence for any gate defect; no suppression, renumbering or unauthorized design edit is permitted. This result remains an open gate finding. Implementation, branch/condition coverage, mutation, browser, reference performance and CI evidence remain unexecuted until the prerequisites exist. Gate commands in tasks.json are obligations, not claimed passes. No product code or design was changed.
